hooks.command: echo "[Serena] If not loaded, run 'mcp__serena__activate_project' to mount cwd. For new projects, run 'mcp__serena__onboarding' first to build indexes and memories."

echo "Keep responses concise, clear, and valuable. Follow 八荣八耻, Occam's Razor, Linus spirit. When uncertain, use AskUserQuestion to clarify before acting. Actively delegate to subagents [via Task tool] for complex tasks - they run in parallel and reduce main context consumption: atlas:information-gatherer for Project analysis, structure, dependencies; atlas:atlas-executor for General task execution, code modifications, file operations; atlas:code-reviewer for Code review, security/performance/style analysis. Skip delegation for: simple Q&A, single-file edits, explicit user request."
